risk_summary: The enrollment endpoint marks a device trusted from a reusable token and a self-declared serial number without proof of ownership or fresh device attestation.

missing_controls: re-enrollment review for existing serial numbers

expected_findings.reason: Trust is created from mutable identifiers without authoritative device ownership proof.
The enrollment token is reusable and not bound to a user or device key.
Downstream consumers may suppress step-up based on a trust state created by the weak enrollment path.
